services.desc: Experience the breathtaking magic of Islamorada sunset cruises with Clearly Unique Charters, where romance meets natural splendor on the crystal-clear waters of the Florida Keys. Our intimate sunset boat tours take you to the perfect vantage points on the Gulf of America, where you’ll witness spectacular sunsets that paint the sky in brilliant oranges, pinks, and purples while enjoying premium beverages and comfortable seating aboard our stable vessel.
